articles.title: SAF Repels Large-Scale RSF Attack on Wadi al-Hout
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: The SAF repelled a large scale RSF attack on Wadi al-Hout in North Kordofan, maintaining defensive positions in the region as fighting continues.

articles.title: Central Bank of Sudan Resumes Operations in Khartoum
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: The Central Bank of Sudan announced the resumption of its operations in Khartoum for the first time since the civil war began, signaling return of institutional functions.

articles.title: SAF Drone Strike on Abu Zaima Market
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: Five people were killed in an SAF drone strike on a market in Abu Zaima, North Kordofan, as fighting continues in the region.

articles.title: SAF Retakes Habila and Breaks Siege of Dalang
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: The SAF retook Habila and broke the siege of Dalang in South Kordofan, advancing strategic positions against the RSF.

articles.title: SAF Drone Strike on Dalang
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: Five people were killed in a drone strike on Dalang as SAF operations continue in contested areas of South Kordofan.

articles.title: RSF Concentrates Combat Vehicles in North Kordofan
articles.description: RSF forces concentrated more than 150 combat vehicles in Bara and Um Badr in North Kordofan as part of a major military buildup and repositioning strategy.

articles.title: RSF Redirects Forces from Darfur to Kordofan
articles.description: RSF sources confirmed forces were redirected from South and North Darfur during April to expand territorial control, pausing South Kordofan operations to reprioritize targets.

articles.title: RSF Drone Strike on Dalang
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: Two people were killed in an RSF drone strike on Dalang as RSF forces claimed to have shot down an SAF Bayraktar drone over the city.

articles.title: RSF Detained 17 Zaghawas in East Darfur
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: The RSF detained 17 Zaghawas from Mahajeriya in East Darfur, including the head of the rural court, in operations across North Darfur.

articles.title: RSF Retakes Bara and Karnoi in North Darfur
articles.source: Wikipedia Timeline of the Sudanese civil war (2026)
articles.description: The RSF retook Bara as well as Karnoi in North Darfur near the border with Chad, consolidating positions in the western region.
